- Updated version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
- No changes to functionality or output format.
- Documentation and metadata updates only; no user-facing feature changes.

- Updated version metadata to 1.0.1 in _meta.json.

- Initial release of poc-battle-card skill.
- Supports input of POC results, competitor performance, and evaluation criteria for structured competitive analysis.
- Outputs an advantage matrix, differentiated insights, competitor response strategies, suggested sales pitches, and next-step recommendations.
- Automatically generates concise battle card summaries in Markdown; PPT/Word formats available on request.
- Emphasizes factual analysis and actionable strategies, avoiding speculation or biased reporting.
